points.title: Create: which inputs besides name and address, and is customer required
behaviours: Create requires name and address only; customer reference is optional and may be set later by 'correct a project'
Create also requires a customer reference (R0-01 lists it as identity) and refuses a project without one
points.who_notices: Cabinet Kernel and onboard_object, whose create calls without a customer either succeed or are refused; PresuPro/Client Portal reading an empty customer in context

points.title: Correct: are blank name/address refused as on create
points.quote: the project with the new name, address or customer
behaviours: Correction applies the same rule as create and refuses an empty name or address
Correction accepts any supplied value, so a project can end up with an empty name or address
points.who_notices: Staff in the frontend; consumers whose context snapshot then carries an empty display name or address

points.title: List rooms on an unknown project: empty list or not found
points.quote: | list rooms | staff, consumer service | the project's rooms in a declared order | — |
behaviours: Unknown project id returns an empty room list (no failure, as the table says)
Unknown project id is refused as not found, like 'list artifacts' ('unknown project') and 'read a project'
points.who_notices: Consumer services that mistype a project id and either see 'no rooms' or an error

points.title: What a room is: its input and identity are unnamed
points.quote: | add a room | staff, consumer service | the room in the project |
behaviours: A room is a name only; two rooms with the same name in one project are allowed
A room has a name unique within the project and a duplicate is refused
points.who_notices: Cabinet Kernel / operator adding rooms on replay; downstream services launched with a room_id

points.title: 'Archived only when asked': included alongside active, or archived alone
points.quote: the projects, archived only when asked
behaviours: Asking adds archived projects to the active ones (all projects)
Asking returns only archived projects
points.who_notices: Staff browsing the archive in the frontend; any consumer that counts projects

points.title: Artifact history: does 'list artifacts' include superseded versions
points.quote: Publishing a new version of a type supersedes the previous one; the history stays readable.
behaviours: 'list artifacts' returns every version, published and superseded
'list artifacts' returns only published pointers, and history is readable some other way (by id) that no action in the table carries
points.who_notices: Consumer services and staff looking for an older estimate version

points.title: Scope of supersession: per project, per room, or per producer
points.quote: the previous published version of that type becomes `superseded`
behaviours: Supersession is per (project, type): a new estimate for any room supersedes the project's previous one
Supersession is per (project, room, type) or per (project, type, owner service), so several published pointers of one type coexist in a project
points.who_notices: Consumers calling 'read the latest of a type', who get one pointer or must choose among several; producers publishing room-level documents (launch context carries room_id)

points.title: Replay of an artifact publish
points.quote: the new version, `published`; the previous published version of that type becomes `superseded`
behaviours: An identical second publish (same uri/payload_ref) creates another version and supersedes the first
An identical second publish returns the existing version unchanged
points.who_notices: PresuPro retrying after a timeout; consumers seeing duplicate history entries

points.title: No action to withdraw a pointer whose artifact the owner deleted
behaviours: Pointers can only be superseded; a pointer to a deleted estimate stays 'published' and dangles
A producer can withdraw/revoke its pointer, leaving no published artifact of that type (or the previous one restored)
points.who_notices: Consumers following the latest pointer to a document that no longer exists; the producer service that deleted it

points.title: 'display name' in the pinned context vs 'name' in identity
points.quote: id, display name, status, address, customer, created and updated times
behaviours: display name is the project's name, unchanged
display name is derived (e.g. name plus address or customer) and differs from name
points.who_notices: PresuPro and Client Portal, which pin the context fields and show the value to users

points.title: What changes the 'updated' time in the pinned context
behaviours: updated changes only on correct and archive of the project itself
updated also changes when a room is added or an artifact pointer is published
points.who_notices: Consumers that refresh their snapshot when updated moves; Client Portal showing 'last updated'

points.title: Is onboard_object inside the product boundary
points.quote: through the Registry frontend or an operator script (`onboard_object`)
behaviours: onboard_object is part of the re-authored Registry and is specified and rebuilt with it
onboard_object is an external caller of the HTTP API that the Registry does not own and only must not break (OQ-08)
points.who_notices: The owner/operator running onboarding after the re-authoring

points.title: 'Nothing is deleted' vs personal data if OQ-01 brings it here
points.quote: the project, status `archived`; nothing is deleted (V1-7)
behaviours: Customer contact data stays forever with the archived project, never erased
Contact data can be erased or corrected on request while the project record is kept, needing an action no promise carries
points.who_notices: The customer exercising data-protection rights; the owner answering for it

points.title: Option (a) of OQ-01 needs customer actions no promise carries
points.quote: a Customer record in Registry, with `customer_ref` becoming its identity
behaviours: Customers are created/corrected implicitly through 'create/correct a project' with inline contact data
Customers are a separate record with their own create/read/correct actions, shared by several projects of one customer
points.who_notices: Staff entering a returning customer's second project; the agent reading the phone for the WhatsApp link
